text:
Support Sarah: Hitting a bunch of customer tickets from EU1 about 502s and timeouts to the hosted API since ~09:12 UTC. Multiple customers say requests either hang for >10s or return 502/gateway errors. Repro with curl returning 502.
Alice: I can see a spike in 502s on the eu1 ingress LB starting 09:11. Rate of 5xx up ~15x. Latency p50/p95 both climb.
Ben: Packet loss alerts firing from our edge probes in eu1 -> eu1-az-b path. MTR shows intermittent 30-60% loss at hop 7 (carrier exchange).
Carol: Copy. Pasting a quick curl I ran from my laptop: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"test"}'``` Response: "HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway

{"error":"upstream socket hang up"}"
Dima: Traceroute from our eu1 worker into the gateway-proxy cluster shows huge RTT/jitter and occasional ICMP unreachable from transit network. Snippet: ```traceroute to gw-proxy.eu1 (10.1.2.3), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  gw-eu1-1 (10.1.0.1)  0.4 ms  0.3 ms  0.3 ms
 2  carrier-pe-1 (203.0.113.5)  2.1 ms  2.8 ms  2.3 ms
 3  carrier-core (203.0.113.10)  18.7 ms  120 ms  34.2 ms  (packet loss sometimes)
 4  gw-proxy.eu1 (10.1.2.3)  *  *  * (timeouts)```
Ops Maria: Looks like a carrier transit flap between our eu1 POP and the upstream provider. Could be BGP or an overloaded peering.
Support Sarah: Customers asking for ETA. We should open an incident and communicate. Flagging P1? Affects hosted inference region with many customers.
Alice: I'd escalate to P1. Creating Incident INC-177600 now. Notifying on-call.
IncidentsBot: Incident INC-177600 created by Alice. Severity: P1. Paging on-call.
Ben: Quick mitigations: 1) Shift routing for latency-sensitive traffic to eu-west-2 as a fallback policy (smart routing). 2) Increase proxy retries and reduce request timeouts temporarily to avoid client-facing 502s. 3) Notify provider to investigate BGP flap.
Dima: Implementing forced route to eu-west-2 for new requests via config toggle. Pushing canary at 09:30. If customers are pinned to eu1 model variants, we'll need to fallback them to compatible variants in eu-west-2 — hitting model-compat check now.
Carol: I've opened a support case with provider (ticket #PROV-9812) and attached MTR/traceroute graphs. Provider acknowledges anomalous flaps on their peering and says they're investigating a DDoS mitigation rule that may have overreacted.
Support Sarah: Customers want repro steps and evidence. Sharing curl/traceroute examples and we asked them to switch region or retry.
Alice: Patch commands used for fallback (for runbook): ```# toggle smart routing fallback
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' https://console.internal/api/v1/routing/toggles -d '{"fallback_region":"eu-west-2","force":true}'
# temporarily bump retries for proxy
curl -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' https://console.internal/api/v1/proxies/gw-proxy/settings -d '{"retries":5,"timeout_ms":20000}'```
Dima: After routing flip, error rate dropped ~70% within 4 minutes for new requests. Old connections kept failing (idle sockets), we cycled the proxy pool to force reconnects.
Ben: Note — we saw an issue where some customers pinned model versions to eu1-only endpoints. For them we returned 503 with a clear "region unavail" message and guidance to re-route. Preparing a mitigaton script to temporarily accept cross-region model routing.
Ops Maria: Running proxy pool restart now to clear stuck sockets. Expect brief additional 502s during drain (~30s). Notifying SRE.
InfraBot: Deploy plan accepted. Restarting proxies in eu1. Rolling restarts (batch size 3) in 60s.
Support Sarah: Posting to affected customers on status page and support tickets: brief summary, mitigation (temporary routing to eu-west-2), apology, and ETA TBD.
Carol: Provider says they applied a dampening rule and removed the offending mitigation at 09:42 UTC. They've restored stable paths. They're monitoring.
Alice: We're seeing errors return to baseline after 09:45 for most flows. A few customers still hitting 502s due to pinned endpoints — we're working through manual reassignments.
Dima: Root cause summary for postmortem draft: upstream transit provider applied an overly aggressive DDoS mitigation / route dampening on a core exchange causing intermittent packet loss and path instability between our eu1 POP and their network. This led to increased RTT, socket hangs, and 502s at the gateway.
Ben: Immediate action items: 1) Continue monitoring for 24h. 2) Add provider AS to eBGP monitoring and alerting (mtr/health) and add louder alert thresholds for packet loss at hop 5-8. 3) Document runbook for forced region failover and customer communication templates.
Support Sarah: Customer comms updated. Will follow up with customers who had pinned endpoints and offer credits where appropriate.
Ops Maria: Final status: mitigated at 09:45 UTC, incident resolved for majority at 09:46 UTC, manual follow-ups ongoing. Closing on-call rotation.
IncidentsBot: Incident INC-177600 status changed to RESOLVED.
Alice: Filing a postmortem ticket and assigning to eng-networking + ops for root cause and durable mitigations.
Support Sarah: Thanks everyone — will keep customers updated in their threads. :heart:
